test_title: PYST 18: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

You know that I am fond of reading / and also that all books are my favourite / but you don't know that this is one of / my favourite book.

options.text: but you don't know that this is one of
and also that all books are my favourite
You know that I am fond of reading

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. my favourite book contains the grammatical error.
